meta.title: eRFX Auction stage with Duration 15 Mins
gaps: Directly verify that Bidding Ends At is exactly 15 minutes after Bidding Starts At on Project Details.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify that Bidding Ends At is exactly 15 minutes after Bidding Starts At on Project Details.

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Keep the project configured with an Auction stage.
Configure the Auction stage before selecting its template and items.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet for the added item.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing vendor names.
Set and save the event duration to 15 minutes.
Verify the saved schedule displays the requested 15-minute duration.
Publish the configured eRFX Auction event.
Confirm publishing reached a real project page.
